AUDIO_SETTING_IMPORT_FORMAT_DESC_1: 'Smart' keeps files eqTrainer can already play (WAV, MP3, FLAC, OGG, Opus) exactly as they are, and converts anything else — to FLAC if the original was lossless, or to Opus if it was already lossy.
AUDIO_SETTING_IMPORT_FORMAT_DESC_2: The other options convert everything to the specified format.
AUDIO_SETTING_IMPORT_FORMAT_DESC_3: 'FLAC' is a lossless compression codec that provides excellent audio quality at about half the size of WAV files. 'Opus' is a lossy compression codec that offers good quality for critical listening, and 'WAV' is an uncompressed lossless codec that provides the best audio quality but results in large file sizes.
AUDIO_SETTING_RECOMPRESS_DESC: Re-encodes WAV clips in your library to FLAC. FLAC is lossless — the audio is identical — and usually about half the size. Clips imported as Opus or FLAC are left alone, and nothing is ever re-encoded into a lossy format.
AUDIO_SETTING_RECOMPRESS_CONFIRM:
Recompress {_COUNT} WAV clips to FLAC?

They currently use {_SIZE} and should end up near {_AFTER}. The audio is unchanged; this only reclaims disk space.
AUDIO_SETTING_RECOMPRESS_DONE_WITH_ERROR: Recompressed {_COUNT} clips, freeing {_SAVED}. {_FAILED} could not be converted and were left as they are.
AUDIO_SETTING_CARD_VOLUME_COMP_DESC: Attenuates playback volume proportionally to the EQ gain to prevent clipping. Disabling this keeps volume constant but may cause clipping at higher gain values.
AUDIO_SETTING_CARD_BACKEND_DESC: If audio is not playing as expected, Try changing audio backend API.
AUDIO_SETTING_BACKEND_AUTO_DESC: Let the audio engine choose. Prefers AAudio on Android 11 and later.
AUDIO_SETTING_BACKEND_AAUDIO_DESC: Lower latency, Android 8+. Falls back to OpenSL ES where AAudio is unavailable.
AUDIO_SETTING_BACKEND_OPENSLES_DESC: Most compatible, Android 4.1+. Recommended for digital audio players.
AUDIO_SETTING_BACKEND_RESTART_NOTE: The audio backend is selected when playback starts. Restart eqTrainer for the change to take effect.
